agents.name: billing_agent
agents.description: Explains billing charges using RAG-based policy retrieval and structured billing facts. Accepts a natural-language query that should embed the customer ID and date range so the agent can parse and retrieve relevant policies.
capabilities: Explain specific billing charges and line items for a customer.
Retrieve and cite relevant billing policy documents via RAG.
Compare customer-claimed amounts against actual invoiced totals.
Generate detailed billing reports and analytics for customers.
Handle billing dispute inquiries by referencing policy rules.

query.description: A natural-language billing question. IMPORTANT: embed the customer ID (e.g. 'customer CUST-1001') and date range (e.g. '2019-07-01 - 2019-07-31' or 'July 2019') directly inside the query text so the agent can parse them. Example: 'Why was customer CUST-1001 charged $150 for July 2019?'

customer_id.description: Optional explicit customer ID. If omitted, the agent will parse it from the query string. Format: CUST-1001

start_date.description: Optional explicit ISO start date, e.g. 2019-07-01T00:00:00. If omitted, the agent parses dates from the query string.

end_date.description: Optional explicit ISO end date, e.g. 2019-07-31T23:59:59. If omitted, the agent parses dates from the query string.

agents.name: anomaly_detection_agent
agents.description: Detects usage anomalies for the demo households over a requested billing window. For the demo, prefer a natural-language query containing `CUST-1001` or `CUST-1002` and a month with year like `Did customer CUST-1001 have a spike in July 2019?`.
capabilities: Analyze large datasets to identify anomalies and outliers.
Use machine learning algorithms to improve anomaly detection accuracy over time.
Provide real-time alerts and notifications when anomalies are detected.
Integrate with various data sources and monitoring systems.

query.description: A natural-language anomaly question. Include `CUST-1001` or `CUST-1002` and a month with year, for example `Did customer CUST-1001 have a usage spike in July 2019?`

customer_id.description: Optional billing customer ID like CUST-1001. For the demo, supported values are CUST-1001 and CUST-1002.

user_id.description: Optional numeric anomaly user ID, e.g. 5997. This is mainly for direct testing; the demo should usually use customer_id.

start_date.description: Optional ISO format start date optionally with timezone, e.g. 2019-07-01T00:00:00-05:00. If omitted, the agent parses dates from the query.

end_date.description: Optional ISO format end date optionally with timezone, e.g. 2019-07-31T23:59:59-05:00. If omitted, the agent parses dates from the query.

agents.name: customer_lookup_agent
agents.description: Returns customer account profile, plan details, and billing summary.
capabilities: Look up customer profile and account details for billing and general context
Retrieve current plan, pricing, and discount eligibility.
Summarize billing history for specific accounts.

query.description: Natural-language question about a customer. Include CUST-1001 or CUST-1002.

customer_id.description: Optional explicit customer ID like CUST-1001.

agents.name: conversation_summary_agent
agents.description: Summarize previous conversations and extract key takeaways from the orchestrator.
capabilities: Extract key facts from executed agent pipelines
